title: Keninjal language - Wikipedia
text: Keninjal (Dayak Kaninjal) is a Malayic Dayak language of Borneo. Glottolog once classified Keninjal as a Western Malayic Dayak language alongside Kendayan, but Smith (2017) includes it in the Ibanic branch of Malayic based on phonological evidence.

title: Keninjal language — Grokipedia
text: The Keninjal language descends from Proto-Malayic, the reconstructed ancestor of the Malayic subgroup within the Austronesian family, which likely originated in Borneo around 4,000 years ago following post-Proto-Malayo-Polynesian migrations via Palawan and along river systems like the Kapuas.
